title: Pig Instance Segmentation Reliability Assessment: code, frozen splits and audit records
description: Research code and documented experimental artifacts for a date-disjoint, compute-matched evaluation of YOLO11n-seg, YOLO26n-seg and Mask R-CNN ResNet50-FPN for pig instance segmentation on the public FaroPigSeg dataset (three training seeds per model). Includes 37 cleaned Google Colab notebooks (data audit, frozen date-disjoint partition, training, harmonized COCO mask evaluation, counting, calibration, efficiency, equal 60-min NVIDIA L4 training-budget experiments and a single retrospective test evaluation), frozen split manifests with SHA-256 fingerprints, result tables, an independent NumPy compressed-RLE mask-AP verifier and an automated repository audit. FaroPigSeg images and labels are not redistributed (CC BY-NC 4.0; obtain them from the dataset authors). The associated manuscript is not yet accepted or published.
